entities.summary: Sajjad Anoushiravani Hamlabad is the President of Islamic Republic of Iran Weightlifting Federation since June 2022. He is an Iranian weightlifter in the +105 kg category. He was the head coach of Iran's weightlifting team at Rio Olympics in summer 2016, that won two golds. Sajjad won the silver medal at the 2012 Summer Olympics in the men's +105 kg category with a total of 449 kg.
